reader.requirement: At 1985 STRING must refuse an identifier-3 that is an edited item (numeric edited, alphanumeric edited - which in 1985 includes A/X with B, 0 or /, since a 1985 alphabetic picture holds only A) or that carries JUSTIFIED (JUST, RIGHT optional), while unedited alphanumeric, alphabetic, group and numeric DISPLAY receivers stay legal.
reader.edition-search: grep of StringUnstringBinder.cs for Edition|CobolVersion|IsAtLeast|Dialect|ConstructRegistry: ctx.Edition appears only as the diagnostic sink (BoundRejected.Report / BoundOperandError.Report -> EditionContext#Error, severity fixed by the descriptor) and as a position scope (EditionContext.At); grammar rules stringStatement/delimitedByPhrase/strUnstrOperand (CobolIO.g4) carry no version predicate; the only edition gate on the statement is src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Validation/VersionConformancePass.cs#VisitStringStatement (StringDelimitedOmitted2002, the omitted-DELIMITED form), which is not this rule's predicate.
